nom: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Pure Hyaluronic Acid Face Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report burning, redness, stinging or rash they attribute to the added fragrance, while others with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin say the serum calmed redness and caused no reaction at all.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report increased hydration, a softer/more supple feel, and improvement of dry patches or flaking.
segments.oily: The few reviewers describing oily or combination-oily skin report the serum absorbs without greasiness and did not increase oiliness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it works well under makeup, absorbs quickly, and can replace a moisturizer without pilling.
segments.mature: Reviewers focused on fine lines and wrinkles report visible softening of lines and a plumper, brighter look with regular use.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report reduced appearance of fine lines, forehead lines and laugh lines, plus a plumper, brighter look after weeks to months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Widely reported as effective: reviewers describe long-lasting hydration, disappearance of dry patches, and a smoother, more supple feel; one reviewer needed only occasional use to maintain results.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea or general redness report it calmed their skin and reduced redness over time; conversely, multiple other reviewers report the fragrance caused new redness, burning or a rash.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers with eczema-prone skin report improved comfort and hydration without irritation from this product specifically.
concerns.spots: A small number of reviewers report lightening of scarring or dark spots and more even skin tone with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention acne-prone skin report no new breakouts or actual clearing of acne; however, at least two reviewers report developing painful cystic acne after starting the serum.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers who mention oily skin report the serum absorbs without leaving a greasy or slimy residue, though one reviewer separately notes it leaves an oily finish.

extraits.texte: I used this due to sudden PD that i have had for over a year. I saw a lot of good reveiews so i purhcased as i already have lots of products from this brand. After 2 days of using my face is stinging, red, and so irritated. There is a very strong fragrance in this bottle, which is likely why my face is so red. If you are sensitive to that, beware. Really sad, really wanted to like this especially for the price

extraits.titre: Fragrance is a no for me
extraits.texte: This is a great serum minus the fragrance. The fragrance triggered my allergy to certain fragrances (proven through skin testing at my derm) and gave me red skin and a rash on my eyelids. Burned when I applied it after the first few times. Too bad, because it does feel very smooth and the few times I did use it my skin felt so soft. Returned.

I would buy it again. It seems to help with redness and small bumps on my cheeks due to mild rosacea. It helps with dryness and my skin felt smooth and moisturized but not oily. It layered well under my moisturizer and did not pill. I havent used it long enough to be able to say its helping with fine lines, but my skin does seem to appear "brighter" (im fair/light in makeup) and moisturized. I took off 1 star because it has added fragramce. Why do companies still add fragrance to skincare? It's unnecessary abd just another thing that can irritate skin.

I've had acne since I was about 12 years old. It took me until 6 months ago to find out that hyaluronic acid completely clears my skin, and I'm 26. I tried the cerave HA serum, and though it cleared my skin, it also caused burning. When I ran out, I started breaking out all over again. I decided to try pure HA this time, and this immediately cleared my skin. No burning at all, as expected. I have no choice but to continue buying this because it works so well!

As someone with combination skin & eczema, it's been challenging trying to find the right balance of products under makeup. This serum is so good because it also replaces the moisturizer so no more makeup pilling and my skin looks & feels more plump and hydrated. Absorbs quickly and has a slight sticky finish that when worn on bare face days goes away after a few minutes giving a glass skin effect but when applying makeup it gives a grippy primer effect so i've cut down the amount of products i need with just this one.

A friend of mine recommended this to me along with the La Roche-Posay Lipikar Wash AP+ Gentle Foaming Moisturizing Wash. This combination is a force to be reckoned with. My skin is almost always clear these days (minus hormonal acne, that's a beast of its own). This doesn't irritate my rosacea and helps keep my skin hydrated. I have tried with a few different face moisturizers and haven't had any reaction to multiple different combinations.
I lovee it at first but, After using for a few days, i started to get painful cycstic acne :(
